charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1101_100_20:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] unexpectedly
ran into Urbain, who asked to battle.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_300_10:
I wanted to relax and do more sightseeing
around Pasio...
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_400_10:
But whenever I see strong-looking Trainers,
I get the urge to battle them.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_500_10:
Let’s battle a ton and get stronger on
Pasio, too!
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_600_10:
Lumiose has this big tournament called the
Z-A Royale. Wait—did I tell you already?
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_700_10:
Anyway, Harmony and I competed,
strengthening each other as we raised
our ranks.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_800_10:
My Meganium grew and learned to Mega
Evolve—the Evolution that transcends
all others!
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_900_10:
When Mega Evolved, Meganium packs even
more punch!
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1000_10: That said, I need to be careful.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1100_10:
His strength isn’t the only thing Mega
Evolving powers up.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1200_10:
You see, Meganium’s petals give off an
aroma that calms aggression.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1300_10:
But when Mega Evolved, Meganium have
more flowers. If you breathe in too much of
their aroma, it can agitate instead.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1400_10:
That’s why it’s important to know WHEN to
Mega Evolve.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1500_10:
Wouldn’t wanna agitate an already
worked-up opponent, y’know?
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1600_10:
I get kinda heated during battle, so I’ve
gotta get better at staying calm and
analyzing the situation.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1700_10:
Speaking of which, now that we’ve battled,
how about a break?
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1800_10:
Too many battles will just wear us out.
Let’s hit up a café or something!
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_0401_100_10: Wow, you’re raring to go, huh.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_0401_200_10: Wait a minute. Don’t tell me...
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_0402_200_10: Wait... You seem a little TOO chill...
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_1900_10:
You weren’t affected by Meganium’s aroma,
were you?
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_2000_10: Or are you usually like this?
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_2100_10:
Either way, we can battle whenever, so let’s
do it again another time!
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_2200_10:
I’m sure I’ll call on you plenty while helping
people and Pokémon on Pasio.
charaepi_ch0367_00_gai/2301_1201_2300_10:
But for now, let’s head to that café and have
a chat so I can learn more about you!
